data.fullPrompt: Warm japandi interior. White oak, cream linen, terracotta clay, brushed brass. Soft diffused morning light through sheer curtains. Dark walnut storage bed with warm cream linen upholstered headboard centered against soft slate blue wall. 65 inch Samsung Frame TV wall-mounted above headboard displaying abstract art in walnut bezel. Brushed brass swing-arm sconce at headboard right casting diagonal shadows across wall. Jute rug layered with rust-ochre wool runner extends beneath bed. Shot on Hasselblad X2D 100C, 24mm tilt-shift at f/8.
